The Last Assistant Architect is a purrkin located in any neighborhood where Consortium Consternation is the active endeavor. He appears in Untethered Space in the Town Center in Founder's Point or the Common in Razorwind Shores. Beside him is a ramp made out of floating objects. Stepping onto it grants the following buff, which transforms you into a purrkin: : The ramp leads up to a rooftop, where more objects and roofs form a platforming course. Untethered Tethers throughout the course can be interacted with to create temporary Phase-Lost Shortcuts, which allow players to quickly get back up. The goal is a floating gazebo. "The Lilac and the Stone" is a short story by Catherynne M. Valente published digitally on the official site on 17 June 2024. It is also part of the anthology The Voices Within. It is illustrated by Ognjen Sporin. It focuses on Moira Thaurissan's thoughts and worries about dwarven politics and parenthood, and on the future of Moira's son Dagran Thaurissan II, who has shown more interest in books than in his heirship of the Bronzebeard and Dark Iron thrones.

The Mighty Lynx is an Arathi airship that continually travels counterclockwise in a large oval-shaped route high above central Hallowfall, approximately from just east of the Sanctified Grounds in the northwest to the area above the Fangs and Rumshackle in the southeast. According to Sky-Captain Dornald, the Mighty Lynx has a personality similar to the namesake cats: temperamental and hard to control, but reliable when needed.

The Reven Pack was a charity bundle that was available for purchase from the Battle.net Shop from 25 October 2024 to 7 January 2025 and consisted of the pet Reven (for retail and Classic progression realms) and the backpack transmog Reven's Comfy Carrier (for retail). 100% of the purchase price was donated to [https://cureduchenne.org/ CureDuchenne], a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving and extending the lives of people with . It was created in memory of World of Warcraft player and Duchenne patient Mats "Ibelin" Steen and released in association with the international release of The Remarkable Life of Ibelin, a documentary film about his life. The Remarkable Life of Ibelin, originally marketed as Ibelin, is a 2024 Norwegian documentary film directed by about the life of World of Warcraft player Mats "Ibelin" Steen (1989–2014). The film consists in part of home movie footage and interviews with Steen's family and friends, and in part of machinima-style animation dramatizing scenes from Steen's online life in his guild Starlight, based on excerpts from his personal blog and on thousands of pages of archived text from Starlight's roleplaying sessions and forum conversations. .]] The Starchaser is an Arathi airship found in Siren Isle. It is the first airship to explore the world since the Arathi's arrival in Hallowfall. World of Warcraft: The Voices Within is a short story anthology serving as a tie-in to . It was released on 31 December 2024. It consists of six stories by different authors, each centering around one of the major characters of the expansion. The first five stories were gradually released for free on the World of Warcraft website prior to the expansion, with the final one—Little Spark—being exclusive to the anthology.

The Underpin is the delves nemesis during The War Within Season 2. In between season one and two, Brann Bronzebeard ran into the Underpin and had his hat and curios stolen in I Want My Hat Back. Brann turns around and asks players to recover his hat and defeat The Underpin in Defeating the Underpin. In the non-challenge delves, The Underpin can invade much like how Zekvir did in season one. In addition to other currency drops, the invading Underpin drops a Delver's Bounty map if one hasn't already dropped for the week. Players can force an Underpin spawn by using the Wave Scrambler 2000 after activating the respawn stone inside any delve.

The Untethered Horror concludes the Phase Diving introduction quest series. Completing this quest is required to unlock the campaign skip for alts. To begin, complete the campaign through chapter three (The Tabiqa), equip the Reshii Wraps, and speak with Shad'anis at the Oasis to start Another World.

The War Within animated shorts is a series of animated shorts released as a prelude to World of Warcraft: The War Within. Unlike previous animated shorts series, no title beyond "The War Within" has been announced for the series as a whole, with each episode having an individual title instead. The first episode, Threads of Destiny, released on August 6, 2024. The second episode, Alleria: Light and Shadow, was released on August 15. Threads of Destiny plays in-game during the max-level The War Within (achievement) campaign quest Making of a Monster.
The War Within Pathfinder is an exploration achievement earned by completing a series of The War Within achievements. This is one of the criteria of Worldsoul-Searching.
The World of Warcraft: The War Within Original Soundtrack is the digital soundtrack for World of Warcraft: The War Within. It was released on , and on 26 August 2024.

The War Within Season 1 (or Season 38) is the first season for both PvP and PvE that began on 10 September 2024. TWW Season 1 equipment could no longer be upgraded after 25 February 2025, but much of the season's other content (such as Let Me Solo Him: Zekvir) remained available until the start of TWW Season 2 on 4 March.

.]] Theater Troupe is a public event in the Proscenium on the Isle of Dorn, run by Stage Manager Huberta, that takes place at the top of each hour. It is unlocked upon reaching renown 3 with the Council of Dornogal. The event is divided into two phases, a preparation phase, where players complete various tasks to prepare the stage for the play and a show phase in which players participate in the play.
